additional_info.subject: ID0466835-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799100] Terminal issue CRM:03055000433
additional_info.body:
Hello Cedric, good afternoon.
I checked the Router remotely and I see a "fair" signal:
RSRP -
Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) is an RSSI type of measurement, measured in dBm. It is the power of the LTE Reference Signals spread over the full bandwidth and narrowband. Values closer to 0 indicate better signal strength.
Which means that we see a poor signal of transmission.
This might be the reason why the OCPP some times drops and comes back.
From our side, the router looks completely ok and nothing to be done.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
